spans.s:
मकत्, a familiar diminutive of 3. म (according to
the Bhāṣya on Pāṇ.
, e. g. मकत् पितृक).
मकत् मकत्. See 3. म, p. 726, col. 3.
मक् मक्, ind., see Gaṇa Svar-ādi to

मक्क् मक्क् [cf. rt. मस्क्], cl. 1. A. मक्-
कते, &c., to go, move.

मक मक, अस्, अम्, m. n., see Gaṇa Ardhar-
cādi to Pāṇ.
मक-दत्त, अस्, m., N. of a man.
मकक मकक, अस्, m. in Atharva-veda
VIII. 6, 12

(perhaps a particular kind of animal, or
bleating, lowing, fr. rt. 2. मा).

मकमकाय मकमकाय (an onomatopo-
etic verb), मकमकायते, &c., to croak (as a
frog), to make a croaking noise.

मकर मकर, अस्, m. a kind of sea monster
sometimes confounded with the crocodile, shark,
dolphin, &c., (properly a fabulous animal regarded as
the emblem of Kāma-deva, the god of love, cf.
मकर-केतन below; also a symbol of the ninth
Arhat of the present Ava-sarpiṇī); N. of the tenth
sign of the zodiac (Capricornus); the tenth arc of
thirty degrees in any circle; a particular species of
insect or other small animal; an array of troops in
the form of a Makara (Manu
VII. 187

); an ear-ring
in the shape of a Makara [cf. मकर-कुण्डल
below]; the hands folded in the form of a Makara;
one of the nine treasures of Kuvera; one of the
eight treasures of the magic art called Padminī; a
particular magical spell recited over weapons; N. of
a mountain; (ई), f. the female of the sea monster
Makara; N. of a river.
—मकर-कटी, f., N. of a
woman.
—मकर-कुण्डल, अम्, n. an ear-ring
shaped like a Makara.
—मकर-केतन, अस्, or म-
कर-केतु, उस्, or मकर-केतु-मत्, आन्, m. ‘hav-
ing the Makara for an emblem,’ or ‘having a fish
on his banner,’ epithet of Kāma-deva, the god of
love.
—मकर-दंष्ट्रा, f. ‘Makara-toothed,’ N.
of a woman.
—मकर-ध्वज, अस्, m. ‘Makara-
bannered,’ epithet of Kāma-deva, the god of love;
a particular array of troops; a particular medical
preparation (= रससिन्दूर-विशेष).
—मकर-
पाटक, अस्, m., N. of a village.
—मकर-राशि, इस्,
m. the sign of the Hindū zodiac corresponding with
Capricornus.
—मकर-विभूषण-केतन, अस्,
m. ‘having the Makara for a characteristic ornament,’
epithet of the god of love.
—मकर-सङ्क्रमण,
अम्, n. the passage of the sun from Sagittarius into
Capricoruns.
—मकर-सप्तमी, f., N. of the
seventh day in the light half of the month Māgha
(see माकरी सप्तमी under माकर).
—मकरा-
कर (˚र-आक्˚), अस्, m. ‘receptacle of Makaras,’ the
ocean.
—मकराकार (˚र-आक्˚), अस्, m. a variety of
Cæsalpina Banducella (= षड्-ग्रन्थ).
—मक-
राक्ष (˚र-अक्˚), अस्, m. ‘Makara-eyed,’ N. of a
[]
Rākṣasa (son of Khara).
—मकराङ्क (˚र-अङ्˚),
अस्, m. ‘having the Makara for a symbol or mark,’
epithet of the ocean; of the god of love.
—मक-
रानन (˚र-आन्˚), अस्, m., N. of one of Śiva's
attendants.
—मकरालय (˚र-आल्˚), अस्, m. ‘Ma-
kara-abode,’ epithet of the ocean; a symbolical ex-
pression for the number four.
—मकरावास (˚र-
आव्˚), अस्, m. ‘Makara-abode,’ the ocean.
—मक-
राश्व (˚र-अश्˚), अस्, m. ‘whose horse is the Makara,’
epithet of Varuṇa.
—मकरी-पत्त्र, अम्, n. or
मकरी-लेखा, f. the mark of a Makarī (on the
face of Lakṣmī; cf. पत्त्र-भङ्ग, पत्त्र-लेखा).
—मकरी-प्रस्थ, अस्, m., N. of a town.

मकरायण, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to or coming
from Makara.

मकरिन्, ई, m. ‘full of Makaras,’ epithet of the
ocean.

मकरन्द मकरन्द, अस्, m. the juice or
nectar of flowers [cf. मरन्द], the honey of
flowers; a species of jasmine; N. of various persons;
of an astronomer; of a work (= कुसुमाञ्जलि-म-
करन्द or सुपद्म-मकरन्द); the Indian
cuckoo (= कोकिल); a bee; a species of fragrant
Mango; (अम्), n. a filament (especially of the
lotus-flower); N. of a pleasure-garden in Ujjayinī.
—मकरन्द-कण, अस्, m. a drop or particle of
flower-juice.
—मकरन्दकणाय, Nom. A. -यते,
to be like drops or particles of flower-juice.
—मक-
रन्द-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, rich in the juice of flowers;
(अती), f. the flower of Bignonia Suaveolens.
—मक-
रन्द-विवृति, इस्, f., N. of a commentary by
Citsukha Muni on the Nyāya-makaranda.
—मक-
रन्द-शर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a preceptor.

माकरन्द माकरन्द, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. मक-
रन्द), coming from or consisting of the juice of
flowers.

मकरन्दिका, f. a kind of metre, four times
˘ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯, ˘ ˘ ˘ ˘ ˘ ¯, ˘ ¯ ˘ ˘ ¯ ˘ ¯; N. of a
daughter of a Vidyā-dhara.
मकष्टु मकष्टु, उस्, m., N. of a man.

मकुआण मकुआण, अस्, m., N. of a race of
kings.

मकुट मकुट, अम्, n. = मुकुट, a head-
dress, crown, tiara, crest.

मकुति मकुति, इस्, m. f. an edict or govern-
ment order addressed to the Śūdras (= शूद्र-शा-
सन).

मकुर मकुर, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt.
मङ्क्, to adorn), a looking-glass, mirror; the stick
or rod or handle of a potter's wheel; the tree Mimu-
sops Elengi (= वकुल); a bud; Arabian jasmine;
[cf. मुकुर.]
मकुराण, N. of a place.

मकुल, अस्, अम्, m. n. the tree Mimusops Elengi;
a bud; [cf. मुकुल.]

मक्कुल मक्कुल, अस्, m. red chalk (= शिला-
जतु), a mineral substance considered variously to be
chalk or benzoin.

मकुष्ट मकुष्ट or मकुष्टक, अस्, m. =
मकुष्ठ below.

मकुष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, slow, going slowly, =
मन्थर; (अस्), m. or मकुष्ठक, अस्, m. a
species of kidney-bean or of rice; [cf. मुकुष्ठ,
मपष्ट.]

मकूलक मकूलक, अस्, m. a species of
medicinal plant (commonly called Danti, = मुकू-
लक).

मकेरुक मकेरुक, अस्, m. a kind of para-
sitical worm.

मक्कल्ल मक्कल्ल, अस्, m. a dangerous abscess
in the abdomen (peculiar to lying-in women).
मक्कोल, अस्, m. chalk, &c.

मक्ष् मक्ष् [cf. rt. म्रक्ष्], cl. 1. P.
मक्षति, &c., to collect, heap, accumu-
late; to be angry.

मक्ष, अस्, m. or आ, f. a fly (Ved.; cf. मश,
नील-म्˚, मधु-म्˚); (अस्), m. hypocrisy, the
concealing of one's own defects; wrath; multitude
(see म्रक्ष); [cf. Zend makhshi, ‘a fly:’ Gr.
μυ-ῖ-α, ‘a fly;’ μοθ-ΐ-α: Lat. mus-ca: Old Germ.
muc-ca, ‘a gnat:’ Angl. Sax. micge = Eng. midge:
Old Norse my: Slav. mucha = Lith. musé, ‘a fly.’]
—मक्ष-वीर्य, अस्, m. the plant Buchanania
Latifolia.

मक्षिक, अस्, आ, m. f. (said to be fr. rt. मश्,
Uṇādi-s.

; cf. मशक), a fly, bee; [cf.
निर्-म्˚, धेनु-म्˚, मधु-म्˚.]
—मक्षिका-मल,
अम्, n. ‘excretion of bees,’ wax.
मक्षीका, f. = मक्षिका above.

माक्षिक माक्षिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. मक्षिका),
coming from or belonging to a bee; (अम्), n., scil.
मधु, honey; a kind of honey-like mineral sub-
stance or pyrites, (various kinds are described, see
स्वर्ण-म्˚, रूप्य-म्˚, कांस्य-म्˚, विट्-म्˚); [cf.
Old Germ. wahs, ‘wax;’ Angl. Sax. väx, vex, veax;
Lith. waszka-s; Russ. vosk.]
—माक्षिक-ज, अम्,
n. ‘honey-born,’ bees’-wax.
—माक्षिक-फल, अस्,
m. a species of cocoa-nut (= मधु-नालिकेरिक).
—माक्षिक-शर्करा, f. a kind of sugar, candied
sugar.
—माक्षिक-स्वामिन्, ई, m., N. of a place.
—माक्षिकाश्रय (˚क-आश्˚), अम्, n. bees'-wax;
honey-comb.

माक्षीक, अम्, n. = माक्षिक, honey.
—मा-
क्षीक-धातु, उ, n. a kind of pyrites (described
above).
—माक्षिक-शर्करा, f. clarified sugar (=
सिताखण्ड).

मक्षु मक्षु or मक्षू, ind. (properly a
form in loc. pl. fr. rt. मंह्; cf. मङ्क्षु, मं-
हना), Ved. quickly, rapidly, soon, promptly, imme-
diately, directly, (in Ṛg-veda
VIII. 26, 6

, a form
मक्षुभिः = शीघ्र-गमनैः occurs); (उस्), m.,
N. of a man; [cf. Zend mashu, moshu; Lat.
mox.]
—मक्षुङ्-गम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (accord-
ing to Sāy.) = शीघ्रं गच्छन्, going quickly.
—मक्षू-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. very prompt,
most prompt or quick, (Sāy. = शीघ्रतम.)

मक्षूयु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. quick, rapid, fleet,
(Sāy. = शीघ्र-गन्तृ.)

माकन्द माकन्द, अस्, m. the mango tree;
(ई), f. the Myrobalan tree, Myrobalan; N. of other
plants (= Hindī माद्राणी, माकुनी); yellow sandal-
wood, yellow sanders; N. of a city on the Ganges.

माकन्दक, अस्, इका, अम्, belonging to the town
Mākandī; (इका), f. = माकन्दी, the city.
माकन्दिक, अस्, m., N. of a man.

माकलि माकलि, इस्, m. the moon; N. of
Indra's charioteer; [cf. मातलि.]

माकष्टेय माकष्टेय (fr. मकष्टु), a pa-
tronymic.

माकारध्यान माकार-ध्यान, अम्, n. (pro-
bably fr. I. मा + कार), a particular method of ab-
stract meditation, kind of reverie.
माकिम् मा-किम्, see Gaṇa Cādi to
मा-कीम्, ind., see Gaṇa Cādi to

,
(according to Sāy.) = १. मा; [cf. न-कीम्.]

मा-किस्, ind., Ved. not (= Lat. ne, e. g. Ṛg-veda
1. 147, 5, मा-किर् no दुरिताय धायीः, consign us
not to misfortune); no one (= Lat. ne-quis, e. g.
Ṛg-veda
VIII. 5, 39

, मा-किर् एना पथा गात्, let
none proceed by that path; according to Sāy. अनेन
मार्गेण अन्यो न गन्तुं शक्नोति).

माकी माकी, f. du., Ved. (Sāy.) = निर्मा-
त्र्यौ भूत-जातस्य, the two creators or originators
of all beings, (said of heaven and earth.)

माकीन माकीन, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. 3. म), Ved.
(according to Sāy.) my, mine.
माकुलि माकुलि, इस्, m. a kind of snake.

माकोट माकोट, N. of one of the places in
which Dākṣāyaṇī is worshipped.

माक्षव्य माक्षव्य, अस्, m. (fr. मक्षु),
[]
Ved. a patronymic, N. of a preceptor; [cf. मां-
क्षव्य.]
